save_strategy: Manual save at the start of every chapter — the game has 15 slots, no mission replay and no New Game Plus.
Keep one untouched save from just before the final mission.
Keep a Chapter 1 save until Positive Mental Attitude pops.
Save before Race Against Yago (Chapter 3, time-sensitive).
Save before bank vault and armored truck jobs.
Never test cheats on your trophy save — cheats switch off trophies and saving.

stages.subtitle: The opening, the one missable, and your first saves
tasks: Manual save at the start of Chapter 1
Lucia's balcony meditation done before Chapter 1 ends
stages.tip: Do the balcony meditation the morning after Down to Earth — it is the only missable interaction in the game, and there is no mission replay.
stages.title: Chapter 1 — First Steps

stages.subtitle: Switching unlocks; the partner trophies open up
tasks: Rob Kingpin Bowling with Sticky Bombs
stages.tip: Finish Breakfast Run to unlock switching — Hot Together and Retail Therapy both need your partner beside you.
stages.title: Chapter 2 — Partners in Crime

stages.subtitle: Robbery tools arrive; the time-sensitive race appears
tasks: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner
Do Race Against Yago the moment it appears
Steal a jet from a VCIA boarding bridge
Get a Rhino tank at Mile Zero Air Station
Win a drone race at 7 of 14 locations
stages.tip: Race Against Yago is time-sensitive (hourglass icon) and feeds Strangers & Freaks — save first, then race the moment it appears.
stages.title: Chapter 3 — The Heat Rises

stages.subtitle: Bank vaults, gangs and the late-story missions
tasks: Complete That's Where The Money Is (unlocks vaults)
stages.tip: Vault jobs give you 4 stars straight away — escape one with your partner and Hot Together pops too.
stages.title: Chapter 4 — Empire & Vaults

stages.subtitle: Six finales and the stranger strands, all still open after the credits
tasks: Max Strength for both Jason and Lucia
stages.tip: Andy is Lucia-only; Tyrone and Bret are Jason-only. Andy's, Billy's and Tyrone's strands do not count toward Strangers & Freaks — they have their own trophies.
stages.title: Side Stories — Strangers & Freaks

stages.subtitle: The 100% checklist: stunts, challenges, collectibles
stages.tip: Do not hunt everything: the checklist only needs selected portions of most activities. Check Progress > Stats > 100% Completion after the story and finish only what is left.
stages.title: The Long Grind — 100%

stages.subtitle: The finale, 100% completion, and the unconfirmed five
tasks: Untouched manual save before the final mission — then check 100% and finish the platinum
stages.tip: The five hidden trophies in this stage have no confirmed unlock method at launch — check the sources for updates; do not trust unconfirmed methods.
stages.title: The Final Push — Platinum
trophies: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
